text:
maria: Opening a docs PR for a new long-context variant: 'Orion-XL-LongCtx'. Need quick sync on a few documentation gotchas before I mark it ready for review.

maria: Items I plan to cover in the card: usable context guidance, quantization compatibility notes (CPU fallback), explicit statement that embeddings are not supported, streaming+function-call example, and benchmark appendix with multiple seq lengths.

liam: can you drop the SDK snippet here so we can sanity-check it?

maria: Pasting the proposed SDK v3 streaming example (aiming for simplicity):
```
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="${RW_KEY}")

with client.chat.stream(model="orion-xl-longctx") as stream:
    stream.call_function("extract_sections")
    for chunk in stream:
        print(chunk.text, end="")
```

maria: Thinking of adding a short v2 one-liner and linking to migration notes instead of full duplication.

anya: Quick notes: 1) The model reports max_sequence = 8192, but due to tokenizer overhead and system prompts the safe usable context is closer to 8150 in practice. Recommend showing a tiny formula and example so folks don't hit silent truncation.

liam: 2) For quant profiles: the 4-bit CPU fallback works only with profile-lite. profile-compat will fail at runtime. Please list explicit mappings in a small table.

maria: Good call. I'll include a compatibility table row for 'profile-lite (cpu 4-bit) = supported', 'profile-compat = not supported'.

dev-bot: New PR created: github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5489 by maria (draft). Checks: spellcheck, linkcheck queued.

sam: Benchmarks: we currently publish latency for seq=2048 in the card, but our catalog index shows seq=1024. That mismatch will confuse users. Recommend adding an appendix table showing 1024/2048/4096 samples plus a short note that latency grows > linearly for large seq. I can generate the small chart as a PNG to attach.

maria: Please do. Also calling out that embeddings are intentionally blocked for this family (policy) to prevent accidental calls to embeddings endpoints. We should recommend the Orion-Embed family as the alternative.

anya: Add a sentence: "Embeddings: not available for Orion-XL-LongCtx. Use Orion-Embed models for embedding tasks."

liam: One more interoperability note: streaming + function-calls works, but memory usage increases with large function schemas. Suggest adding a small warning and an example of trimming the schema.

maria: I'll add that under "Streaming and function-calls" and include a small code tip for schema minimization.

ci-bot: linkcheck started. Found 1 broken link: /sdk/reference/v3/ -> should be /sdk/v3/reference.

maria: Fixed link and pushed. Also added the compatibility table and a short usable_context example showing simple math: 
```
reported_max = 8192
reserved_meta = 32  # system + safety tokens
prompt_padding = 10
usable_context = reported_max - reserved_meta - prompt_padding  # ~8150
```

sam: Attached bench PNG comparing 1024/2048/4096. Also updated bench text to clarify test harness parameters: batch size 1, fp16, GPU A5000, tokenization uses byte-level tokenizer.

liam: Language nit: prefer '4-bit quantized CPU fallback (profile-lite only)' rather than '4-bit CPU fallback'.

maria: Updated wording and pushed. Also included a short v2 one-liner and link to migration guide instead of full v2 example.

dev-bot: PR 5489 updated by maria 7 status: open, draft removed.

anya: Quick review: table looks good, bench appendix is clear, linking to migration guide for SDK v2 is ideal. Left one nit about wording in the streaming caveat.

maria: Addressed the nit. Waiting 30 minutes for final objections then will squash-merge.

liam: No objections from me. Looks ready. Thanks for moving quickly.

maria: Merged PR 5489 and published to staging docs. Release note: "Catalog entry updated for Orion-XL-LongCtx: clarified usable_context, CPU quant profile compatibility (profile-lite only), embeddings policy, streaming+function-call caveat, and benchmark appendix."

dev-bot: PR 5489 merged by maria 7 Deploy to staging docs initiated.

ci-bot: deploy succeeded to staging; smoke tests passed.

sam: I'll file a follow-up issue to track telemetry for truncation-related errors post-launch. Issue #3129.

maria: Thanks all. If telemetry shows truncation spikes we will update the card with stronger warnings and example prompt sanitizers.
